in_sanskrit.name: विश्वक्सेन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vishva meaning 'universe' and ksena meaning 'protector' or 'commander'. Vishvaksena is a name of Lord Vishnu and is also the name of the commander-in-chief of his army.

in_marathi.name: Vishvaksena
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Commander of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishvaksena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishvaksena is the name of Lord Vishnu's commander in charge of maintaining the order and harmony of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Vishvaksena
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Commander of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishvaksena একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vishvaksena is the name of Lord Vishnu's commander in charge of maintaining the order and harmony of the universe.
